role: Native historical OOF research replay, NOT prospective forecasts or calibrated probabilities

semantics.decision_score: Class-balanced expert score used by frozen point-decision policy, NOT event probability
semantics.component_mass: Approximate prior unbalance for classifier or raw quantile mass for density; requires evaluation/calibration, NOT established probability
semantics.label: T+20 realized class, available only once label_end_date strictly precedes a calibration/refit date

label_timing_rule: Every later calibrator must use label_end_date < current decision/refit date; never random CV.
